    def test_run_new_backtest(self, page: Page, create_session):
        login_page = LoginPage(page)
        bot_details_page = BotDetailsPage(page)
        bots_page = BotsPage(page)
        backtest_page = BacktestPage(page)
        notifications = Notifications(page)
        bots_api = BotsApi()
        toast_message = "Backtest was successfully created"
        delete_toast_message = "Backtest was successfully deleted."
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            login_page.goto()
            create_session()
    
        with allure.step("Go to bots page"):
            bots_page.goto(endpoint=bots_page.slug)
    
        with allure.step("Click on first bot card"):
            response = bots_api.get_bots()
            first_name_bot = response['items'][0]['name']
            bot_id = response['items'][0]['id']
            bots_page.click_bot_card(first_name_bot)
    
        with allure.step("Click on backtest tab"):
            bot_details_page.click_on_page_tab('backtest')
    
        with allure.step("Run a backtest"):
            bot_details_page.click_run_new_backtest_btn()
            bot_details_page.select_market(option_value=False)
            selected_market = bot_details_page.get_dropdown_select_market_value()
            bot_details_page.click_run_backtest_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Verify running backtest"):
            notifications.wait_for_success_toast()
            assert toast_message in notifications.get_success_toast_message()
            notifications.close_toast_message()
            assert bot_details_page.get_backtest_table_market_coin() in selected_market
            assert bot_details_page.get_backtest_table_market_coin(stable_coin=False) in selected_market
    
        with allure.step("Go to backtest details page"):
            bot_details_page.click_on_backtest_row()
    
        with allure.step("Verify backtest page"):
            expect(backtest_page.page.locator(backtest_page.locPageTitle)).to_contain_text(backtest_page.title)
            try:
                assert "completed" in backtest_page.wait_for_backtest_status(expected_status="completed", max_attempts=7)
            finally:
                with allure.step("Delete backtest"):
